info.name: Reflektive Real-time Feedback (v1) Real-time Feedback (v1) Real-time Feedback (v2) API

params.name: created_before
params.description: A UNIX timestamp representing the oldest time a feedback was created. Defaults to the time the request was issued.

params.name: created_after
params.description: A UNIX timestamp representing the most recent time a feedback was created. Defaults to 1 day prior to the time the request was issued.

params.name: page
params.description: An offset for the feedback results. The endpoint returns 200 results per query.

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of all public, positive real-time feedback records using the v2 schema. The v2 endpoint adds support for Team Recognition — feedback sent to multiple recipients simultaneously. By default 200 results are returned per query.
